text: A synthetic demo disk with fictional paths, scanned by RillDisk 0.1.3
Size counts every byte; Clean up counts what removal would actually free
Git worktrees: four found, with their size and what removing them frees
Each worktree is checked with your own Git, read-only
118 days idle, yet Git reports an uncommitted edit: it stays Review first
A commit that exists only on a detached HEAD would be lost: kept
Bulk select ticks only worktrees with no Git-reported changes and no recent work
Removal asks first, uses the Recycle Bin, and checks Git again right before each worktree
Right-click any folder: Show in Explorer, copy its path, or scan just that folder
